#| label: load-data

library(ggplot2)

## Hypothesis 1

Different employment status can predict daily free time.

### Variables and descriptive statistics 这个label是比##hypothesis 1更低一级的标题。上面说的会出现目录就是这些标题。

- **Sex at birth (`Sex_birth`):** A categorical variable with three groups: Male, Female, and Intersex.
- **Importance of partner physical attractiveness (`preference_imp_physat`):** Points allocated to physical attractiveness from a total budget of 30 points across six partner characteristics. Higher values indicate greater relative importance.

```{r}
#| label: h1-descriptives
# Count respondents in each group.
table(h1Data$Employment)

# Summarize attractiveness points separately for each group.
by(h1Data$Time_free_1, h1Data$Employment, summary) #show分类变量（sex）的各个水平中连续变量（imp_physat）的情况
```

### Graph

@fig-attractiveness shows the distribution of points by sex at birth. The half-violin shows the shape of the distribution, the box summarizes the median and quartiles, and the dots represent individual responses.

```{r}
#| label: fig-attractiveness
#| fig-cap: "Points allocated to daily free time, by employment status." ########### 这个是加图注的！
#| 
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(h1Data, aes(x = Employment, y = Time_free_1,
                   fill = Employment)) +
  geom_rain(alpha = 0.5, point.args = list(alpha = 0.04, size = 0.6)) +
  labs(x = "Employment Status", y = "Daily free time") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


## H2. People who have more daily free time will have higher level of collectivistic attitude #两个井号就是第一级标题（或许是第二级？）

collectiveistic attitude is associated with daily free time.

### Variables and descriptive statistics

- **collective attitude:** How strongly someone prioritizes group welfare over personal rewards and goals. These items express collectivistic values. Responses range from 1 (Definitely disagree) to 7 (Definitely agree).

This dataset includes respondents who were dating, in a committed relationship, or married.

```{r}
#| label: h2-descriptives
summary(h2Data[, c("Time_free_1", "collectTotal")])
```

### Graph

@fig-commitment shows the relationship between daily free time and collective attitude. Points are jittered to make overlapping responses easier to see; the recorded scores are unchanged. The line summarizes the linear trend.

```{r}
#| label: fig-collectivistic attitude
#| fig-cap: "Daily free time and collectivistic attitude."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(h2Data, aes(x = Time_free_1, y = collectTotal)) +
  geom_jitter(width = .12, height = .04, alpha = .04, size = .6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Daily free time (minutes/day)",
       y = "collectivistic attitude (1–7)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Observed trend

```{r}
#| label: correlation
r <- cor(h2Data$Time_free_1, h2Data$collectTotal, use = "complete.obs")
round(r, 2) #保留几位小数。r是需要操作的值，2是位数。
```

The correlation was `{r} round(r, 2)`, indicating a weak negative association. Respondents who reported more confidence in finding a new partner tended to report lower commitment.
